entries.requirement: apply an avalanche/mixing step to a hash value before reducing it to a bucket index
guard copy assignment against self-assignment as the first statement, before any destructive mutation
publish a rehashed table's new bucket array only after its allocation succeeds, without destroying any existing node on the failing path
reduce a hash value to a bucket index using a prime bucket count with plain modulo instead of a power-of-two mask
relink existing nodes into new buckets during resize instead of copying and destroying every key and value

Fix three confirmed defects in Coin's internal SbHash<Key,Type> chained hash table (broken const-only iterator, a self-assignment that clears the source before copying it, and a resize that is not exception-safe and leaks live objects when a key/value copy throws mid-rehash) and decide whether resize should relink existing nodes instead of copying them, informed by how mature hash table implementations handle the same problems.
